courses.title: TIE Fighter Navigation OS: Vector Programming in C++
courses.description: Master the art of writing navigation algorithms for TIE/LN starfighters. Covers inertial guidance, hyperspace coordinate calculations, and collision avoidance for tight formation flying.

courses.title: Death Star Reactor Core: Real-Time Systems Programming
courses.description: Learn to write stable real-time monitoring software for the DS-1 reactor core. Topics include thermal regulation algorithms, emergency shutdown protocols, and redundant system failover — because one exhaust port is already enough.

courses.title: Stormtrooper Targeting Systems: Introduction to Computer Vision
courses.description: A beginner-friendly introduction to computer vision and targeting algorithms. Warning: historical accuracy data suggests graduates achieve only 12% hit rate — your code can only improve from here.

courses.title: Imperial HoloNet: Distributed Systems & Message Queues
courses.description: Build and maintain the Empire's galaxy-wide communications network. Covers distributed message queues, cross-system replication, and secure point-to-point holo-transmissions. Because the rebellion is always listening.

courses.title: Probe Droid Firmware: Embedded Systems & IoT
courses.description: Program the firmware for Viper probe droids deployed across the galaxy. Learn sensor data processing, autonomous navigation, and secure data transmission back to the nearest Star Destroyer.

courses.title: AT-AT Walker Control Systems: PLC & Motion Programming
courses.description: Program the gait control and balance systems for All Terrain Armored Transports. Includes walking pattern generation, terrain adaptation, and synchronized marching for maximum intimidation.

courses.title: Imperial Databases: SQL for Dark Side Analytics
courses.description: Query and manage the Empire's vast intelligence databases. Learn to track rebel cell movements, analyze Senate voting patterns (before it was dissolved), and identify force-sensitive individuals across the galaxy.

courses.title: Lightsaber Combat Simulator: Game Physics Programming
courses.description: Build virtual training simulations for force-sensitive Imperial Inquisitors. Covers physics engine development, particle effects for lightsaber clashes, and force push/pull mechanics in Unreal Engine.

courses.title: Death Star II Construction: Project Management with Jira
courses.description: Manage galaxy-scale construction projects. Learn Agile methodology adapted for Imperial efficiency, resource allocation across star systems, and why the first Death Star's project management failure was a design review problem, not a security one.

courses.title: Imperial Cybersecurity: Defending Against Rebel Hackers
courses.description: Protect Imperial systems from Rebel Alliance cyber attacks. Covers network penetration testing, data encryption, secure API design, and why you should never, ever leave thermal exhaust ports unsecured in your architecture.
